theme.name: The Botanical Swiss (Premium Enterprise ESG)
theme.description: A high-end, premium enterprise aesthetic that blends the authoritative, precise geometry of 'Swiss & High-Contrast' with the grounded, trusting palette of 'Organic & Earthy'. Designed specifically for CFOs and Sustainability Heads. It rejects the generic 'SaaS dashboard' look by replacing gray boxes with vast negative space, crisp typography, and deep forest/sage tones. It utilizes progressive disclosure and a split-screen wizard architecture to make complex ESG reporting feel effortless.

typography.strategy: Old Money Tech - Authority meets high legibility.
typography.instructions: NEVER use Inter, Roboto, or Open Sans for headings. Enforce tight tracking on all headings above text-2xl. Use font-light and font-medium strategically to create tension.

colors.instructions: Avoid muddy grays; tint all neutral grays slightly with green (sage). Never use pure black. Ensure button hover states explicitly set text colors. Primary CTA should be the deep forest green (#0D3C26). Accent color (muted gold) is used extremely sparingly for 'Premium/VIP' indicators or 'Active' step highlights in the wizard.

layouts.page_structure: Mobile-first responsive. Use extremely generous spacing (Tailwind p-8 to p-16).
layouts.kpi_dashboard: Mode B: High Density Grid (for data). Use grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-4 gap-6. Summary widgets span 1 col, primary charts span 2-3 cols. No standard Vercel-look cards.
layouts.wizard_flow: Split-Screen Architecture. Left 30-40% of the screen is sticky, displaying progress, overlines, and the active stage (e.g., 'Step 2: ESG Content'). Right 60-70% is the interactive form. This prevents the 'long scrolling form' fatigue.
layouts.drawer: Delivery History uses a side-drawer (Slide-out panel) from the right (w-[400px] or w-[500px]) to show exact generated artifacts without losing the context of the main list.

components.wizard_stepper: Do not use a top horizontal progress bar. Use a vertical, text-rich stepper on the left side. Highlight the active step with the primary color and bold typography. Inactive steps are muted.
components.hierarchical_tree: For ESG Section selection. Do NOT use standard HTML checkboxes. Use expandable nodes. Parent node has an overall status (All, Partial, None). Use pill-shaped badges or custom Radix/Shadcn toggles for selection. Expand to reveal children (Environment -> GHG/Water/Waste).
components.cards: The 'Neumorphism / Clay & Crisp' variant. Use 1px subtle borders (border-border) with very soft ambient shadows (shadow-sm). For hovered interactive cards, elevate to shadow-md with a slight -translate-y-1 transform.
components.facility_selector: Multi-select dropdown with searchable chips. Selected facilities appear as premium rounded chips inside the input area. Provide 'Select All' utility.
components.tables: For Schedules & Delivery. Dense, highly legible. Remove vertical borders. Use horizontal borders only. Frequencies (daily/weekly/monthly) must be formatted in a human-readable badge. Include inline action menus (Edit, Delete, Send Now) via Shadcn DropdownMenu.
components.modals: Use Shadcn Dialog for 'Send Now' confirmations. Style with blur backdrop.
components.empty_states: Premium empty states. Do not just say 'No data'. Use subtle illustrations, an overline, a clear heading, and a primary CTA to 'Create First Configuration'.

motion.instructions: Use micro-interactions for feedback. Hover states on rows and cards. Smooth entrance animations for wizard steps using Framer Motion (opacity 0 to 1, y: 10 to 0). Tree expansions must animate smoothly (height 0 to auto).
motion.accessibility: Respect prefers-reduced-motion. Do not rely on motion alone for state changes.

visual_enhancers.textures: Add a very subtle SVG noise overlay or a faint botanical abstract texture to the sticky left panel of the wizard.
visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Use for the sticky top navigation bar (backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/80 border-b border-border/40) to ensure content scrolling underneath is elegantly blurred.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure minimum 4.5:1 for normal text. Use text-shadow if placing text over any image.
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements (buttons, inputs, menu items, table rows) MUST include a 'data-testid' attribute (e.g., 'data-testid="wizard-next-button"').

corporate_dashboard_bg.description: Empty conference room with a panoramic city view at sunset. Use as an ambient hero background for the Management Overview with heavy white/gradient overlay (bg-white/80 to white).

esg_concept_texture.description: Gray concrete building covered in trees. Use as a subtle decorative image inside the 'Review & Send' step or the 'Empty State' for Schedules.

subtle_green_texture.description: Abstract green plant leaves. Use as a masked background pattern for the left-side panel in the wizard, opacity 5%.

UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui.
Do not center align the App container.
Do not apply 'transition: all'. Explicitly state transition properties.
Never use generic AI emojis for icons; use 'lucide-react' or '@phosphor-icons/react'.
Ensure generous spacing; a dense UI is fine for data tables, but the surrounding layout needs breathing room (e.g., p-8 or p-12 wrappers).
Add 'sonner' for toast notifications on actions like 'Send Now' or 'Schedule Saved'.
For the Hierarchical ESG Content tree, create a custom React component using Lucide icons (ChevronRight, ChevronDown) for expanding/collapsing, and a 3-state checkbox or pill for 'All/Partial/None'.
